claim_shown_impossible: A binary PASS/FAIL consumer can represent a hung jury without information loss.
proof_sketch: NO-DECISION carries unresolved_questions and blocking_objections. Mapping it to FAIL discards those fields and is observationally identical to a decided rejection.
contradiction: If FAIL equals NO-DECISION, then a decided rejection and a hung jury are indistinguishable, contradicting the kind's required fields.
assumptions: Consumers persist only a binary label
Required fields of NO-DECISION are load-bearing
scope: council outcome envelope, not domain task failure
